language.forced: Hive was started in {language} (--lang): this setting applies from its next start.
language.restart: Hive's own text has changed language. Chromium's parts (the PDF viewer, date pickers) follow when Hive next starts.
language.setting.desc: The language Hive shows. Automatic follows Windows' display languages.
language.setting.tip: Languages marked as translated by AI were drafted by agents, and improvements are welcome. Hive speaks to agents and the Hive Assistant in English whatever this says; they can still answer you in your language. Hive started with --lang uses that language until it next starts.
language.setting.title: Language
